description: Games for a sport and Eastern date with start times, status, and plain-language rest and schedule context. Research intelligence (probabilities, factors, context), not winning picks. Price: Free, no signup. Research and information, not betting advice. No outcomes are guaranteed. Adults 21+ only, where legal. Problem gambling help: 1-800-MY-RESET.

date.description: Eastern (ET) date, YYYY-MM-DD, from 3 days ago to 7 days ahead. Defaults to today.

harness.description: Optional display hint. It changes the output format only, never access, price or limits.

sport.description: Sport. One of nba, nfl, mlb, nhl, cfb, cbb, wnba. Defaults to nba.

visual.description: Optional. How to present the result: auto (default, chosen by client), image (picture and link), text (terminal chart), none (data only).

name: get_daily_slate

games.description: get_daily_slate: the games, with slug, teams, start time, status, final score and rest.

relation.description: Where the date sits relative to today (yesterday, today, tomorrow or another day).

schedule.description: get_daily_slate: start-time window, back-to-back teams, short-rest and rest-gap counts.

teams.description: get_matchup_context: each team's last result and next game.

error.description: Failure only: code, message, request_id, billable (false for free tools).

hint.description: Empty day only: the nearest days in the free window that have games (next_games, previous_games).
